'''Haunters''' are a type of [[Mobs]], placed into the [[Preeminent Parasites|Preeminent]] Tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==
*Spawns inside the [[Parasite Biome]], with a spawnweight of 5.
*Can spawn naturally, once a [[Colony]] with at least 25 points exists in the dimension, individually with a spawnweight of 1.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Haunters are relatively mobile Melee/Ranged Hybrid Tanks.
*Haunter's melee attack is performed through contact damage.
*Haunter's melee will occasionally ignore immunity frames in a brief burst of damage.
*Haunters can shoot fast homing projectiles in bursts of 3, these projectiles can phase through walls, but can also be destroyed.
*Haunters regularly perform large evasive dashes.
*Haunters can spawn [[Succor|Succors]].
*Haunters can perform small leaps in liquids.
*Haunters can dive in liquids to pursue submerged targets.
*Haunters can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 15, with a 20 ticks cooldown and 5 Blocks range.
{{Variants|count=1|Armored=ArmoredHaunter.png|TextureDesc=inflicts 1.5x melee damage but has half the HP.}}

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
*Haunters, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
